description: Details required by condition 3a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, k, l, m, and o (submission of details) of listed building consent 24/07094 (Removal of non-original rear additions at garden level; erection of glazed conservatory to the rear of the closet wing at ground floor level; installation of condenser unit within acoustic enclosure at front lower ground floor lightwell; landscaping works to the rear garden; alterations at roof level to provide additional space within the loft to include a rear dormer window and rooflights to front and rear roof slopes; elevational alterations including the removal of security bars from the front, lower ground floor window; and provision of services along with internal alterations throughout)
